title: Layer map matches the code and external binaries are called only from their adapter module
body:
Why: Fable plan 1114e (.krn/runs/overnight/fable-plan-1114e.md) slice 4: scripts/boundaries.ts lists removed areas (hosts, evals->cli/hosts) and unused edges (brain->cli, brain->evals/fr40/tasks.ts); gh argv spread over outcome/ledger.ts, outcome/window.ts, adopt/verify.ts (raw spawnSync), ci/*.
Outcome: stale entries removed; an allowlist ratchet in boundaries.ts maps each external binary (herdr, gh, claude, bw, git) to its owning modules; verify/ledger/window gh calls go through one gh module with captured replies.
Proof: node scripts/boundaries.ts PASS and fails on a new spawn of gh outside the allowlist (test).
